note: Model tags v2 runs may load (v1/models.json is separate and unchanged). digest null = not yet observed: a run records the observed digest in every run record, and it is pinned here after that first run, from /api/tags, never by hand; a run refuses a tag whose digest differs. estimatedVramMb is the VRAM the model needs at the largest context it is run at; null = not measured, and the run then uses --vram-mb or LOCAL_EVAL_MIN_FREE_MB and says which.
